_comment: The playbook hub library: single source of truth for topic clusters. render_hub() in build_pages.py builds /playbook/<slug>/ pages from the 'hub' list; scripts/wire_playbook.py injects the spoke->hub backlinks, the library section on /playbook/, and the blog-index banner.
